name: tofueval
title: TofuEval
description: Factual consistency of topic-focused dialogue summaries from MediaSum and MeetingBank. Each item is one summary, with source documents defining the dev/test split and clustering. Licensed source text is downloaded locally.

splits.name: dev
splits.description: Summaries from the 70 development source documents.

splits.name: test
splits.description: Summaries from the 30 held-out source documents.

license.name: Mixed: MIT-0 (no-training note); MediaSum research use; MeetingBank CC BY-NC-ND 4.0

test_split_note: Held-out test documents are intended for final evaluation. Use the dev split for prompt and adapter development; repeated test evaluation can compromise the holdout.
